verses.text: Ha tikne'ik, tik swalb'at juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'ayex hex anciano ay t'a junjun chonhab', yujto ha hin tik, anciano hin pax heyet'ok. Wilnak wal Cristo chi', wilnak chajtil ajnak yab'an sya'il. Ay walan wik hin cha'an swach'il heyet'ok, haton jun toto ol cheklajelok.

Icha yaj heb' tanhwum kalnel, icha chi' tzeyutej he tanhwan heb' ay t'a yol he k'ab' heyilani, yujto icha skalnel Dios yaj heb' t'ayex. Manh ak'b'ilok pural tzex utaji, manh yujok he nib'anoch tumin tzeyil heb'. Palta yujnhejokab' to icha chi' tz'el t'a he k'o'ol to tzeyil heb', yujto icha chi' snib'ej Dios t'ayex. Tzex munlaj wal t'a tzalajk'olal.
Max yal yajal tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' ay t'a yol he k'ab'. Palta ha he wach' b'eyb'al tze ch'ox yil heb', yik ha tas tze b'eyb'alej chi' ol sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ayik ol ja jun Kilumal Niwan Yelk'ochi, ol he cha spak te niwan swach'il. Ha jun chi' malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwok.

Ha hexxo hex kelemtak yet' hex kob'estak, tze k'anab'ajej wal heb' anciano. Ichokab' hex chi' he masanil, emnakil tzeyutej heyak'an serwil he b'a junjun hex. Yujto syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan icha tik: Ha Dios schakanel heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, haxo pax t'a heb' emnakilal syutej sb'a, syak' wal swach'k'olal, xchi.
Yuj chi' emnakil skutejek ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yujto te niwan spoder. Tato icha chi', niwan ol honh ajelk'och yuj, ayik ol ja stiempo'al.
Kak'ekoch masanil kilk'olal t'a yol sk'ab', yujto aypaxoch ilk'olal ku'uj.
Lista skutej ko b'a ko makwaji, yujto icha yaj nok' choj tz'el yaw tzek' sayek' schib'ej, icha chi' yek' winh ajk'o'ol t'a ko patik kichanh, haton winh diablo.

Te tek'anokab' skutej kak'anoch Dios t'a ko k'o'ol, yik ol yal ko kolan ko b'a t'a winh. Yujto kojtak to ha heb' ketcreyente'al sakleminak yajb'at t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, wan pax yab'an juntzanh yahelal heb' icha honh tik.

Ayik ol lajwok kab'an sya'il janik'ok tiempo'al, haxo Dios ol honh wach' tz'aktzitanok, ol swach' ak'ej ko tek'anil yet' kip. Manh jantakok swach'k'olal, yuj chi' ix honh yawtejoch yikok, yik wach' ay kalan kik t'a swach'il ay t'a jun'elnhej, yujto junxonhej kaj yet' Jesucristo.
Niwanokab' yelk'ochi, niwanokab' spoder t'a masanil tiempo. Amén.

Ha winh kuktak Silvano tik, wojtak spensar winh, sk'anab'ajej wal winh. Ha winh ol ik'anb'at jun hin carta tik t'ayex. Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jay b'elanh lolonel tik, yik ol wach' ja he pensar. Ha juntzanh tik tz'alani chajtil syutej Dios yak'an swach'k'olal t'ayonh t'a wal yel. Ha t'a swach'k'olal tik, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a.
Ha heb' ketcreyente'al ay t'a Babilonia tik, sik'b'ilxo'el heb' heyet'ok, syak'b'at stzatzil he k'o'ol heb'. Yet' pax winhaj Marcos tik, winh icha wuninal yaji, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'o'ol winh.
Slaj heyak'laj stzatzil he k'o'ol yuj he xajanan he b'a. Yak'okab' sjunk'olal Dios t'ayex he masanil hex yik hexxo Jesucristo ta'.
